Fix remaining styling issues in this Next.js marketing site at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq:

## Fix 1: Our Mission Hero — Text Colors After Transparency Fix

The mission hero was changed to transparent bg. Read src/components/our-mission/mission-hero.module.css fully. If heading and subtitle are white text (from the old dark bg days), update to dark navy since the page now has GradientPageBg (Rectangle-1-1.png, light background).

Webflow `.mission-page-banner` uses dark text colors since it's transparent.

- Check `.heading` — if `color: #fff` or white, change to `color: #092245`
- Check `.subtitle` — if white/rgba white, change to `color: #5b616e`  
- Check `.badge` — adjust for light background

Also read src/components/our-mission/mission-hero.tsx to understand the structure.

## Fix 2: How It Works Hero — Text Colors After Transparency Fix

The how-it-works hero was changed to transparent. Read src/components/how-it-works/how-works-hero.module.css fully. 

Webflow `.how-works-banner` has: text-color for h1 = dark (#082753), subtitle = dark.

- If `.heading` has white text, change to `color: #092245`
- If `.subtitle` has white/rgba text, change to `color: #5b616e`
- If badge has dark bg, change to light

Read src/components/how-it-works/how-works-hero.tsx for reference.

## Fix 3: Our Works Hero — Text Readability

The our-works hero is now transparent with WorkPageBg (Rectangle-1-2.png, cover). Read src/components/our-works/our-works-hero.tsx and our-works-hero.module.css.

The Webflow work-banner content has white text (the page background Rectangle-1-2.png is a dark-ish gradient). Keep white text for our-works hero. No change needed if text is already white.

Just verify and report whether the text colors are white — do NOT change them.

## Fix 4: BetaCta text colors on light-background pages  

Read src/components/shared/beta-cta.tsx and beta-cta.module.css fully.

The BetaCta section appears on many pages. Check if it has a dark background that provides appropriate contrast for its content. If the BetaCta section itself has a dark background (like #082753), it should display correctly regardless of page bg. Report whether BetaCta has its own dark bg.

## Fix 5: Contact Hero Badge Styling

After changing contact hero to #effafe background, the badge might need updating. Read src/components/contact/contact-hero.module.css lines 30-80. Verify badge has appropriate styling for a light blue background:
- Badge bg: rgba(33,207,255,0.1) or similar light cyan
- Badge border: #05bafe or cyan
- Badge text: #082753 dark navy

If different, fix to match these values.

Read all files before editing. Only change what's needed to match the described requirements.
